summary: The public/private naming boundary for this repository, stated positively and checked by one gate.

rules: The descriptive part is hyphen-separated words that each begin with a letter, so a public identity cannot encode a queue position or an ordering.
A raw identity field is spelled plainly; a character escape in the source text is rejected even when it parses to a legal identity.
A file path decodes to exactly the identity the document declares.
A private source id or a private alias mapping is not a valid public field.

Where no descriptive name applies yet, the letter c followed by 12 lowercase hex characters is accepted as the public id in its own right; it is minted outside this repository and carries no descriptive words or queue position.
A violation names the contract and the field, and never echoes the value it rejected.
public_identity_contract.legacy_entries: most existing architecture-evidence entries predate this namespace and keep their workstream/card-shaped id; they are not renamed and their history is not rewritten, and rule 4 (path decodes to the declared identity) still applies to them unchanged

private_identifier_scan.scope: every tracked path, every tracked non-binary file regardless of extension, and every symlink target
private_identifier_scan.term_set: supplied at run time from an owner-controlled input outside this repository; no private identifier is committed here
private_identifier_scan.term_set_cardinality: a set of any size; every supplied term is matched and reported independently, so adding another private name is a change to the owner-controlled input, never a change to this repository
private_identifier_scan.public_mode: without a term set the scan reports SKIPPED and asserts nothing, so public CI stays credential-free
private_identifier_scan.private_mode: with --private a missing term set is a hard failure; the scan never reports a pass with nothing to match
private_identifier_scan.output_discipline: a finding names a surface, a normalization rule, and an opaque term reference; a matching path is reported as an ordinal, and the detailed inventory is written only to an explicit destination outside this repository
private_identifier_scan.limits: this is a normalization contract over mechanical, reversible representations; it does not detect encryption or arbitrary obfuscation

gate.receipt: derived at check time and printed; never tracked, so no change has to rewrite a shared aggregate

rendered_copy_assertions.purpose: suites that assert internal vocabulary is absent from reader-facing copy draw their private terms from the same owner-controlled term set, so no such assertion has to spell a private name to make it
rendered_copy_assertions.public_mode: without a term set the internal clause contributes nothing and the assertion still pins its public vocabulary
rendered_copy_assertions.term_set_error: an unreadable term set is an error rather than an empty term set, so a mistyped owner-controlled path cannot read as a quiet pass
rendered_copy_assertions.rationale: an encoded denylist is still a denylist: a digest, a character-code table, or a pair of quoted fragments joined at run time is a mechanical, reversible spelling of the word, and the scan decodes exactly those shapes
